# Monteverde

> A Lean 4 proof that ClayPVersusNP (the LeanMillenniumPrizeProblems formalization of Cook's P vs NP statement: P = NP over every finite alphabet with at least two symbols, for Mathlib's FinTM2 machines) is equivalent to CslibPEqNP (P = NP for every injective binary encoding, in cslib-frontier). Axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. The equivalence is at the level of statements; it does not decide either side.

Main theorems (namespace `Monteverde`, axioms `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound` only):

```lean
def CslibPEqNP : Prop :=
  ∀ {α : Type} (enc : α ↪ List Bool), Cslib.Complexity.P enc = Cslib.Complexity.NP enc

theorem cslibPEqNP_iff_bits : CslibPEqNP ↔ P encBits = NP encBits
theorem clay_iff_cslib : Millennium.ClayPVersusNP ↔ CslibPEqNP
theorem clay_negative_iff_cslib :
    Millennium.ClayPVersusNP.Formulations.NegativeBranch ↔ ¬ CslibPEqNP
```

Reusable bridges: `clayP_iff_cslib`, `clayNP_iff_cslib` (alphabets with at least two symbols), `clayReducible_iff_cslib`, `tm2_iff_computableInPolyTime_words`, `tm2_iff_computableInPolyTime` (any finite alphabets), `TM2ComputableInPolyTime.exists_finite`, `cslibPEqNP_of_image_SAT_mem_P`.

Developed with AI assistance (Claude, by Anthropic). Every proof is checked by the Lean kernel and, independently, by nanoda.

Pins: Lean `leanprover/lean4:v4.36.0-rc2`; cslib-frontier `9bfe667f8c66a8a2a3e17391ce9a5cc965190544`; LeanMillenniumPrizeProblems `603053dc267cf3efe422f438eb78098c0ececd6f` (vendored); millennium-cook-levin `879c4835640119ad009abeb62ebd7a96f87eb9e8` (vendored). Release v1.1.1, 2026-11-23. License Apache-2.0.

Use as a dependency (same toolchain), then `import Monteverde`:

```toml
[[require]]
name = "monteverde"
git = "https://github.com/wbnns/monteverde"
rev = "v1.1.1"
```

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/wbnns/monteverde/blob/main/README.md): full reference. The two definitions of P and NP, the proof by layer, every reusable result, the trust model, build steps, and contributor notes (invariants, build targets, toolchain quirks).
- [Statements](https://github.com/wbnns/monteverde/tree/main/Monteverde/Statements): the headline statements as definitions. They import only the Clay definitions and cslib-frontier's class definitions.
- [Usage examples](https://github.com/wbnns/monteverde/blob/main/Tests/ReadmeExamples.lean): checked in CI.
- [Cook text audit](https://github.com/wbnns/monteverde/blob/main/Audit/cook_text_audit.md): Cook's official Clay problem description mapped to the Lean definitions, with 8 explained differences.

## Checks

- [Axiom check](https://github.com/wbnns/monteverde/blob/main/Audit/Axioms.lean)
- [Statement isolation](https://github.com/wbnns/monteverde/blob/main/Audit/Isolation.lean): each theorem's type must be exactly its statement.
- [Cook-Levin cross-check](https://github.com/wbnns/monteverde/blob/main/CrossCheck/CookLevin.lean): each library's SAT is NP-complete for the other library's definitions.
- [Library size](https://github.com/wbnns/monteverde/blob/main/Audit/size_table.md): theorem counts at pinned commits.
